report.summary: Impact between car-0 and car-1 occurred at t = 4.728 s, with timing uncertainty about 0.05 s. From t = 3.528 to 4.528 s, car-0 was measured at 52.1 km/h (90% interval 47.9 to 56.5) and car-1 was measured at 31.0 km/h (90% interval 28.3 to 33.9). The s1 speed claim for the white car was not consistent with the measured 52.1 km/h (90% interval 47.9 to 56.5), and s1's claim that the light was green could not be checked from the footage. The s2 speed claim for the blue car was consistent with the measured 31.0 km/h (90% interval 28.3 to 33.9). The s2 claim about braking by the white car was consistent with the footage, with no sustained braking detected before impact.
limitations: Frame times come from the burned-in clock; frames the recorder dropped were placed using the vehicles' own motion.
Road calibration error: 0.519 m (how well the clicked road points fit a flat road); positions assume a flat road.

The momentum check after the impact did not balance (inconsistent): after contact the vehicles overlap in the image, so post-impact motion is not reliable. Speeds before the impact are measured separately and are not affected.
Traffic-light claims cannot be checked: 5 traffic lights in view (traffic_light-0, traffic_light-1, traffic_light-2, traffic_light-3, traffic_light-4); choose which one governs the stop line.
Measurements come from one camera; they support expert review and do not determine fault.
